firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently borrowed something and never returned it starts the first round and takes the Starting Player token.
officialTieBreak: If that criterion is tied, choose randomly.
clarifications: The first player to pass during a round becomes the starting player for the next round.
The starting player begins the opening Planning and Action phases; card choices during the draft are made simultaneously.
